name: UnSeenTimeQA
description: UnSeenTimeQA is a data contamination-free time-sensitive question-answering benchmark designed to test large language models' temporal reasoning abilities without relying on memorized factual knowledge. It features synthetically generated facts and three types of time-sensitive questions focusing on sequential and parallel event occurrences.
reputation: A recent synthetic temporal reasoning benchmark that is still emerging and has limited community adoption so far.
notes: Avoids data leakage by using synthetic facts; tests temporal reasoning over long-range and parallel events.
